findings.title: Removing the deferral makes remote chats poll the file list every 30 s without any "@"
findings.body: `useWorkspaceFilePaths` was gated on `fileMenuAsked`. It is now enabled whenever a snapshot exists (SessionChatSurface.tsx:435). For remote hosts, `refetchInterval` returns 30 s unless the workspace is missing (line 2256), so every open remote chat re-reads the whole list twice a minute, whether or not the user ever types "@". On a daemon without the paths route, that read is the slow `/workspace/files` fallback. The PR body says the list is needed for transcript links, but it doesn't mention the polling. Consider polling only while the composer has asked for the menu, or lengthening the interval.

findings.title: Per-host "no paths route" memo is never cleared
findings.body: `hostsWithoutPathsRoute` is a module-level set that only grows. Once a host answers ROUTE_NOT_FOUND (line 2222-2223), every later call goes straight to the slow `/workspace/files` fallback for the life of the renderer. The memo isn't reset when the host disconnects and reconnects (`disconnectHost`/`connectHost`), or when the daemon behind that `hostId` is upgraded. A remote box that gets the new daemon therefore keeps the 1–4 s, 1.2 MB list until the app reloads, with no visible sign. Consider clearing the entry on host (re)connect, or storing a timestamp and retrying the paths route occasionally. The local host is keyed as "", so it would be worth checking whether a daemon restart without a renderer reload is possible.

findings.title: Test shares module-level memo state across tests
findings.body: The memo lives in the module and nothing resets it between tests. Both tests use host `box-a`. The "reads paths from the paths route" test only passes today because it runs first. If the order changes, or a test is added that expects the paths route on `box-a` after this one, it will silently use the fallback. Use `vi.resetModules()` with a dynamic import, or export a reset helper, so each test starts with an empty memo. The new assertion also counts only requests to `/workspace/paths`. A second call to `/workspace/files` is expected, so that's fine.
